Elmer H. Behnke was an American basketball player.

Elmer H. Behnke was selected by the Rochester Royals in the 4th round (35th pick overall) of the 1951 NBA draft.
Elmer H. Behnke played for the Milwaukee Hawks from 1951 to 1952.
